[[Walsh Gymnasium]] |champion= |bowl= [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result = Second Round }} {{2017–18 Big East men's basketball standings}} The '''2017–18 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team''' represented [[Seton Hall University]] in the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were led by eighth-year head coach [[Kevin Willard]]. The Pirates played their home games at the [[Prudential Center]] in [[Newark, New Jersey]] and [[Walsh Gymnasium]] in [[South Orange, New Jersey]] as members of the [[Big East Conference]]. They finished the season 22–12, 10–8 in [[2017–18 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in a three-way tie for third place. In the [[2018 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]], they lost to [[2017–18 Butler Bulldogs men's basketball team|Butler]] in the quarterfinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 8 seed in the Midwest region. There they defeated [[2017–18 NC State Wolfpack men's basketball team|NC State]] in the first round before losing to [[2017–18 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|Kansas]] in the second round. ==Previous season== The [[2016–17 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team|Pirates]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 21–12, 10–8 in [[2016–17 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in a four-way tie for third place. As the No. 5 seed in the [[2017 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]], they defeated [[2016–17 Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball team|Marquette]]{{Cite web|url=http://www.gomarquette.com/sports/m-baskbl/recaps/030917aaa.html|title=Marquette falls to Seton Hall 82-76 in BIG EAST quarters Marquette Golden Eagles Official Athletic Site|website=www.gomarquette.com|access-date=2017-09-20}} before losing to [[2016–17 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|Villanova]] in the semifinals.{{Cite news|url=http://www.nj.com/setonhall/index.ssf/2017/03/seton_hall_versus_villanova_big_east_tournament_se.html|title=Seton Hall loses heart-breaker to No. 2 Villanova in Big East tournament semifinals {{!}} Rapid reaction|work=NJ.com|access-date=2017-09-20|language=en-US}} They received an at-large bid to the [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as a No. 9 seed in the South region where they lost to 8-seeded [[2016–17 Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball team|Arkansas]] on a controversial flagrant foul call late in the game in the first round.{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400946435|title=Seton Hall vs. Arkansas - Game Recap - March 17, 2017 - ESPN|website=ESPN.com|access-date=2017-09-20}}{{Cite news|url=https://www.si.com/college-basketball/2017/03/17/arkansas-seton-hall-controversial-call-ncaa-tournament|title=Arkansas-Seton Hall game decided by controversial call|last=Jones|first=Jonathan|work=SI.com|access-date=2017-09-20}} ==Offseason== === Returning players === Following the season, junior forward [[Ángel Delgado]] declared himself eligible of the [[2017 NBA draft|NBA draft]], but did not hire an agent.{{Cite news|url=http://www.nj.com/setonhall/index.ssf/2017/03/seton_halls_angel_delgado_and_khadeen_carrington_r.html|title=Seton Hall's Angel Delgado, Khadeen Carrington testing NBA Draft waters, report says|work=NJ.com|access-date=2017-09-20|language=en-US}} On May 22, 2017, he withdrew his name from the draft and announced he would return to Seton Hall for his senior season.{{Cite news|url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/2017/05/22/seton-hall-center-angel-delgado-returning-for-senior-season/102019410/|title=Seton Hall center Angel Delgado returning for senior season|work=USA TODAY|access-date=2017-09-20|language=en}} Junior guard Khadeen Carringon also announced he would make himself eligible for the NBA draft, but also withdrew his name from the draft to return to the Hall for his senior season.{{Cite news|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/19438691/angel-delgado-returning-seton-hall-pirates-withdrawing-nba-draft|title=Delgado returning to Seton Hall for senior year|work=ESPN.com|access-date=2017-09-20}} ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
